title: [C II] Properties and Far-infrared Variability of a z = 7 Blazar
question: Properties of the [C II] emission and rest-frame IR continuum of the z=7 blazar host, and whether synchrotron emission from the jet contributes to the IR continuum

data.bands: NOEMA: band 3; ALMA band number not stated (238 GHz continuum)

what.value: VLA radio flux densities of J0410–0139 in 2021 and 2022

evidence.quote: see Table E1 in (cite: banados2024a)

what.value: Black hole mass 6.9 (+0.5/-0.4) x 10^8 Msun and MgII redshift 6.995 +/- 0.001

evidence.quote: powered by a black hole with the mass of $6.9^{+0.5}_{-0.4} \times 10^8$ $M_\odot$ (cite: banados2024a)

what.value: [C II]-SFR relation log SFR = -6.09 + 0.90 x log L_[CII]

evidence.quote: is calculated using $\log \mathrm{SFR}_{\rm \ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}=-6.09+0.90\times \log L_{\rm \ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}$, with $L_{\rm \ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}$ in solar luminosities (cite: delooze2014)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA cubes and continuum
recipe.method: Standard CASA reduction; 40 km/s cubes with natural weighting, cleaned to 2 sigma
key_parameters: 40 km/s channel width, natural weighting, 2 sigma clean threshold

recipe.goal: Measure continuum size and flux of the quasar host
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit to the 238 GHz continuum with imfit

recipe.goal: Extract the [C II] spectrum and total line flux
recipe.method: Spectrum extracted in a 1.5'' radius aperture chosen by curve-of-growth analysis
key_parameters: aperture radius 1.5''; cumulative flux plateaus there for both optical and [C II] centroids

recipe.goal: Fit the [C II] line profile and test for a second component
recipe.method: Fit with one and two Gaussians; compare with BIC; make line images across 1.2xFWHM of each Gaussian and look for 3.5 sigma signal in the shifted component

recipe.goal: Estimate dynamical mass and black hole to host mass ratio
recipe.method: Dispersion-dominated estimate M_dyn = (3/2) R sigma^2 / G following Decarli et al. 2018, with R the major semi-axis of the Gaussian fit of the [C II] map and sigma the line velocity dispersion
assumptions: Dispersion-dominated system (no rotation in channel maps); dynamical mass comparable to stellar mass or bulge mass for the main-sequence and local-relation comparisons

recipe.goal: Derive [C II] luminosity and [C II]-based SFR
recipe.method: log SFR = -6.09 + 0.90 x log L_[CII] with L in solar luminosities

recipe.goal: Compare NOEMA and ALMA continuum with VLA radio to test synchrotron variability and derive IR luminosity and SFR
recipe.method: Compare 224/239 GHz NOEMA (2021) and 238 GHz ALMA (2022) flux densities with quasi-simultaneous VLA data; derive L_IR from a modified black body and SFR_IR following Kennicutt 1998
key_parameters: T_d = 47 K, beta = 1.6, integration over 8-1000 um
assumptions: Mm continuum treated as cold dust to compute IR luminosity, dust mass and SFR_IR

recipe.goal: Estimate the synchrotron contribution needed for consistent [C II] and IR SFRs and place the source on the [C II] deficit plane
recipe.method: Require the [C II]- and IR-derived SFRs to agree and solve for the synchrotron fraction of the mm continuum; compare L_[CII]/L_IR with other z>5.7 quasars
assumptions: Dust-obscured star formation dominates for massive galaxies; host galaxy contribution does not vary on scales of months

evidence.quote: providing a systemic redshift of $z_{\ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}} = 6.9964\pm 0.0005$
FWHM$_{\rm \ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}$ | $206 \pm 40$ | km s$^{-1}$
is the velocity dispersion from the Gaussian fit of the $\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}$ line ($88\pm17\,$km s$^{-1}$)
The total $\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}$ flux is $0.45\pm 0.08\,$Jy km s$^{-1}$
$L_{\rm \ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}$ | $(2.02\pm 0.36)\times 10^{42}$ | erg s$^{-1}$
SFR$_{\rm \ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}^a$ | $58\pm 9$ | $M_\odot\,$yr$^{-1}$
is the major semi-axis of the Gaussian fit of the $\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}$ map ($1.75\pm 0.25\,$kpc)
This results in $M_{\rm dyn,\ensuremath{\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}}}=(4.6\pm 2.0)\times 10^9\,M_\odot$.

answer_key.quantity: Black hole to dynamical mass ratio

evidence.quote: The black hole to galaxy dynamical mass ratio for J0410–0139 is $0.15^{+0.08}_{-0.05}$.

answer_key.quantity: [C II] centroid offset from optical position

evidence.quote: The centroid of the $\text{[C\,\textsc{ii]}}$ is offset by $0.35\ensuremath{''}$ (1.81  kpc) from the optical position.
The source is resolved, with a deconvolved size of $(0.57\pm 0.10)^{\prime\prime}\times (0.68\pm 0.10)^{\prime\prime}$

answer_key.quantity: Continuum flux decrease NOEMA to ALMA

evidence.quote: However, the measured flux densities are inconsistent by $\sim 33\%$

answer_key.quantity: VLA flux density decrease above 3 GHz

evidence.quote: The VLA flux densities above 3 GHz show an average decrement of $\sim 37\%$.

answer_key.quantity: IR-derived SFR if continuum were dust (2021, 2022)

evidence.quote: would be $400\pm 29\,M_\odot\,$yr$^{-1}$ and $295\pm 21\,M_\odot\,$yr$^{-1}$ in 2021 and 2022, respectively

answer_key.quantity: Synchrotron contribution needed for consistent SFRs (2021, 2022)

evidence.quote: the synchrotron contribution needs to be 85% and 80% in the mm observations from 2021 and 2022, respectively

answer_key.quantity: Nearby continuum source 238 GHz flux density

evidence.quote: The integrated flux density is $S_{238\,\mathrm{GHz}}=0.20 \pm 0.04$ mJy.

ALMA flux, bandpass and phase calibrators

How the ALMA continuum was separated from the line (line-free channels and continuum subtraction method)
Functional form and starting parameters of the 1- and 2-Gaussian spectral fits (fitting code, priors, BIC values)
How the continuum flux densities in Table 1 were measured (imfit vs aperture) and how the flux scale uncertainty was set
Method used to compute L_IR uncertainties and the VLA flux densities used in the SED fit (only in Banados et al. 2024a)
Assumptions behind the 85%/80% synchrotron fraction beyond the stated SFR equality
Data availability and release status of 2021.A.00030.S
missing_for_reproduction: ALMA setup (band, spectral windows), CASA version and calibrators
Imaging parameters beyond natural weighting and 2 sigma clean threshold (cell and image size, masks)
Continuum/line separation for ALMA and Gaussian fitting details
VLA flux densities (in Banados et al. 2024a) and the exact SED fitting for L_IR
score_reason: A project code and many numeric results are given and the analysis is simple (imfit, Gaussian line fit, closed-form M_dyn), but ALMA band, CASA version, calibrators and imaging details are missing and public release is not stated.
rediscovery_reason: Single project code (2021.A.00030.S), simple analysis and numeric answer keys (flux, line parameters, M_dyn); the data should be public in the archive though the paper does not state it, and some imaging choices must be inferred.
